title: Inoculation Prompting Robustness Across Model Families

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-family validation of inoculation prompting directly informs whether it can be recommended as a general safety tool. High practical value: if it fails on some families, practitioners need to know.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Follows the established insecure-code fine-tuning methodology. Three model families at 7B are feasible on medium compute (one at a time). The main complexity is managing three separate fine-tuning runs with consistent evaluation. Beginners can follow the published protocol.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three fine-tuning runs with a consistent protocol. Clear deliverable: a suppression effectiveness comparison table. However, three full fine-tuning + evaluation cycles strain the 30-hour budget. Could be reduced to two families.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
